context_requirements: SELP (P-selectin) expression, which is largely restricted to activated endothelial cells and platelets
Presence of the ligand/receptor axis being probed (e.g., PSGL1) for any functional readout
An inflammatory or thrombotic stimulus to induce P-selectin; unstimulated cell lines are unlikely to depend on this pathway
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in known P-selectin/PSGL1 pathway genes or leukocyte adhesion genes after treatment
